description: Stand up the whole-site gate plumbing end-to-end with a temporary accept-any-name match. Middleware rewrites every unauthenticated visitor to a name screen, exempting the gate page, the gate API, static assets, and /admin + /api/admin so the guest gate and admin login never cross. The gate API issues an HMAC-signed ~90-day access cookie (own GATE_SECRET, same crypto pattern as admin auth) carrying guestId/partyId/matchedAt; middleware verifies the cookie signature only, with no Sheet read in the request path. Demoable: the site is private, any typed name lets you in, and a reload keeps you in.
title: Gate scaffold: middleware protection, name screen, and signed access cookie
acceptance_criteria: An unauthenticated visit to any guest-facing route is rewritten to the name screen
/admin and /api/admin are exempt and reach admin's own login, not the guest gate
Submitting the name screen sets a signed cookie and grants access; a reload stays in without re-entering
Middleware verifies the cookie via HMAC only and performs no Sheet read
Gate session sign/verify is unit-tested: valid issue/verify, tamper rejection, and expiry
